title: Introducing SWE-2 Flash
gist: A coding-agent company took an open-weight model, added a large mid-training stage and then reinforcement learning in its own harness, and ships the result as a fast cheap tier. Most of the gain is credited to better training tasks.
changes: Counter-evidence from the tuner's own table: an off-the-shelf open model released around the same time scores about twice as high on the same benchmark as the tuned one.
caveats: Self-reported; compute, task counts and prices are not disclosed and the weights are not public. The comparison models were run in different harnesses.

numbers.value: 20.0 for the tuned model, 42.3 for an untuned general open model
numbers.baseline: the tuned model's own base scored 0.9

bears_on.note: In the tuner's own table, a newer general open model beats the tuned one by a wide margin.
